#!/bin/bash
set -e

# === GhostCore Live ISO Builder ===
# Run this on a Debian/Ubuntu Linux system with root privileges

DISTRO="bullseye"
ARCH="amd64"
WORK_DIR="$(pwd)/work"
LIVE_DIR="$WORK_DIR/chroot"
MIRROR="http://deb.debian.org/debian"
ISO_NAME="ghostcore-rescue.iso"

echo "=========================================="
echo "  GhostCore Live ISO Builder"
echo "=========================================="

# Check if running as root
if [ "$EUID" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[!] Please run as root"
    exit 1
fi

# Check dependencies
for cmd in debootstrap grub-mkrescue xorriso mksquashfs; do
    if ! command -v $cmd &> /dev/null; then
        echo "[!] Missing dependency: $cmd"
        echo "    Install with: apt install debootstrap grub-pc-bin grub-efi-amd64-bin xorriso squashfs-tools"
        exit 1
    fi
done

# Create work directories
echo "[*] Creating work directories..."
mkdir -p $WORK_DIR
mkdir -p $LIVE_DIR
mkdir -p $WORK_DIR/iso/live
mkdir -p $WORK_DIR/iso/boot/grub

# Bootstrap Debian
echo "[*] Bootstrapping Debian base system..."
debootstrap --arch=$ARCH $DISTRO $LIVE_DIR $MIRROR

# Mount system directories for chroot
echo "[*] Mounting system directories..."
mount --bind /dev $LIVE_DIR/dev
mount --bind /proc $LIVE_DIR/proc
mount --bind /sys $LIVE_DIR/sys
mount --bind /dev/pts $LIVE_DIR/dev/pts

# Copy GhostCore tools into chroot
echo "[*] Copying GhostCore tools..."
mkdir -p $LIVE_DIR/opt/ghostcore/tools
mkdir -p $LIVE_DIR/opt/ghostcore/scripts
mkdir -p $LIVE_DIR/opt/ghostcore/logs

cp ../opt/ghostcore/tools/*.py $LIVE_DIR/opt/ghostcore/tools/ 2>/dev/null || true
cp ../opt/ghostcore/scripts/*.sh $LIVE_DIR/opt/ghostcore/scripts/ 2>/dev/null || true

# Create chroot install script
cat > $LIVE_DIR/install.sh << 'CHROOTEOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "[*] Updating package list..."
apt update

echo "[*] Installing Linux kernel and live-boot..."
apt install -y linux-image-amd64 live-boot systemd-sysv

echo "[*] Installing core tools..."
apt install -y \
    python3 python3-pip python3-tk python3-dev \
    wget curl git nano less openssh-client \
    ntfs-3g dosfstools parted fdisk \
    lsof htop tmux screen \
    build-essential unzip \
    xorg xinit openbox pcmanfm lxterminal \
    fonts-liberation fonts-dejavu \
    network-manager net-tools iproute2 \
    yara libyara-dev \
    sleuthkit foremost testdisk \
    chntpw

echo "[*] Installing Python packages..."
pip3 install --break-system-packages psutil yara-python rich pefile python-magic capstone

echo "[*] Setting up auto-login and auto-start..."
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/getty@tty1.service.d
cat > /etc/systemd/system/getty@tty1.service.d/autologin.conf << 'EOF'
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty --autologin root --noclear %I $TERM
EOF

# Autostart X and GhostCore on login
cat > /root/.bash_profile << 'EOF'
if [ -z "$DISPLAY" ] && [ "$(tty)" = "/dev/tty1" ]; then
    startx /opt/ghostcore/scripts/start-ghostcore.sh
fi
EOF

# Set hostname
echo "ghostcore" > /etc/hostname

# Set root password (change this!)
echo "root:ghostcore" | chpasswd

echo "[*] Cleaning up..."
apt clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

echo "[✓] Chroot setup complete"
CHROOTEOF

chmod +x $LIVE_DIR/install.sh

# Run install script in chroot
echo "[*] Entering chroot to install packages..."
chroot $LIVE_DIR /install.sh

# Cleanup chroot
echo "[*] Cleaning up chroot mounts..."
rm $LIVE_DIR/install.sh
umount $LIVE_DIR/dev/pts
umount $LIVE_DIR/dev
umount $LIVE_DIR/proc
umount $LIVE_DIR/sys

# Create squashfs filesystem
echo "[*] Creating squashfs filesystem..."
mksquashfs $LIVE_DIR $WORK_DIR/iso/live/filesystem.squashfs -comp xz -e boot

# Copy kernel and initrd
echo "[*] Copying kernel and initrd..."
cp $LIVE_DIR/boot/vmlinuz-* $WORK_DIR/iso/boot/vmlinuz
cp $LIVE_DIR/boot/initrd.img-* $WORK_DIR/iso/boot/initrd

# Create GRUB config
echo "[*] Creating GRUB configuration..."
cat > $WORK_DIR/iso/boot/grub/grub.cfg << 'EOF'
set timeout=5
set default=0

menuentry "GhostCore Rescue" {
    linux /boot/vmlinuz boot=live quiet splash
    initrd /boot/initrd
}

menuentry "GhostCore Rescue (Safe Mode)" {
    linux /boot/vmlinuz boot=live nomodeset
    initrd /boot/initrd
}

menuentry "GhostCore Rescue (To RAM)" {
    linux /boot/vmlinuz boot=live toram quiet
    initrd /boot/initrd
}
EOF

# Create ISO
echo "[*] Creating bootable ISO..."
grub-mkrescue -o $ISO_NAME $WORK_DIR/iso

echo "=========================================="
echo "[✓] ISO created: $ISO_NAME"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""
echo "To write to USB:"
echo "  dd if=$ISO_NAME of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress"
echo ""
echo "Or use Rufus/Etcher on Windows"

#!/bin/bash
# Mount Windows partitions for forensic analysis

MOUNT_POINT="/mnt/windows"

echo "[*] GhostCore Windows Mount Utility"
echo "===================================="

# List available partitions
echo "[*] Available partitions:"
lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,FSTYPE,LABEL,MOUNTPOINT

echo ""
read -p "Enter partition to mount (e.g., sda2): " PARTITION

if [ -z "$PARTITION" ]; then
    echo "[!] No partition specified"
    exit 1
fi

DEVICE="/dev/$PARTITION"

if [ ! -b "$DEVICE" ]; then
    echo "[!] Device not found: $DEVICE"
    exit 1
fi

# Create mount point
mkdir -p $MOUNT_POINT

# Mount read-only for forensic safety
echo "[*] Mounting $DEVICE to $MOUNT_POINT (read-only)..."
mount -o ro,noexec $DEVICE $MOUNT_POINT

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "[✓] Mounted successfully at $MOUNT_POINT"
    echo ""
    echo "Windows users found:"
    ls -la $MOUNT_POINT/Users/ 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none found)"
else
    echo "[!] Mount failed"
    exit 1
fi
